title: Measuring Implicit Bias Using SHAP Feature Importance and Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting and quantifying implicit bias and discrimination in AI systems, particularly concerning protected features like gender, age, and race. While bias and fairness are significant ethical considerations in AI, the paper does not involve the direct evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks, spiritual traditions, or theological aspects. Its scope is technical methodology for bias detection within pattern classification.
